title: Add CSV export to the report command
problem: Operators need the report in a spreadsheet; today it is HTML only.
behavior: `report --format csv --out <file>` writes one row per item. `report` without the option is unchanged.
implementation_choices: The CSV writer reuses the report's existing snapshot, so both formats read one consistent transaction.

architecture.claim: Business rules stay in the domain module; the CLI only selects the format.

unverified_claims: Very large reports were not measured.

goal_satisfaction.explanation: Every goal clause is met, per the accepted requirements and the coordinator's review.

review_recipe: Export a report from a copy of a sample database and open it in a spreadsheet.
private_evidence: the sealed delivery and run records
commit_message: Add CSV export to the report command
